newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nalco Chemical started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nalco Chemical started.

text.p: J.P. Morgan Securities Inc said Wednesday it had started coverage of Nalco Chemical Co with a market perform rating and a 12-month target of $44 per share, based on a 1998 earnings estimate of $2.32 per share.
-- Analyst Gilbert Yang said in a research note his outlook for Nalco would improve with more aggressive management targets, strategic acquisitions and cost-cutting.
-- Nalco is one of the largest water-treatment companies in the world and its scale will help it to remain a leader, Yang said.
